description:
The work is going to be hard either way. The stress is coming whether you play small or swing big.

So why burn your energy on half-commitments? 

If you’re going to carry the weight, carry it for something that actually moves you forward.

Go all in. The cost is the same…the payoff isn’t.
transcript: Dream way bigger than you think. Dream way bigger. It is the same amount of work to do something 10 times the size to do this one time. It's the same stress. It's the same worry. It's the same fall. You might as well aim bigger.
spoken_hook_0_3s: Dream way bigger than you think. Dream way bigger.
first_sentence: Dream way bigger than you think.
